faqs.question: How can I place an order?
faqs.answer: You can select ‘BUY NOW’ directly on any product to initiate an order inquiry with pre-filled specifications on WhatsApp. Our studio curator confirms piece availability, verifies finish options, and sends direct payment details.

faqs.question: How do I make payment?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, and all major Credit/Debit Cards via our secure encrypted payment links shared by our studio curator upon order confirmation.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: We ship across all pin codes in India with reinforced shatter-safe, eco-friendly wooden packaging. International shipping is also available upon request with custom freight calculation.

faqs.question: How can I check product availability?
faqs.answer: Each product page indicates real-time studio status: In Studio Stock, Limited Batch, or Made to Order. For urgent timelines or specific numbered editions, you can check directly with our studio via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled within 12 hours of placement before safe crate preparation begins. For Made to Order pieces once sculpting has commenced, cancellations may incur a nominal studio material retention fee.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard in-stock deliveries take 3 to 6 business days across metro cities in India. For Made-to-Order wire bonsai trees or hand-cut mosaic pieces, creation takes 5 to 10 days followed by expedited insured courier transit.

faqs.question: How can I contact Brushspace?
faqs.answer: You can reach our atelier directly via WhatsApp or email at contact@brushspace.com. Our showroom curators in Mumbai and New Delhi are available Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 7 PM IST.

faqs.question: Can I order multiple products together?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can add multiple pieces to your cart and click BUY NOW to send a single consolidated WhatsApp list. Our studio coordinates bundled shatter-safe packaging and consolidated shipping discounts.

faqs.question: Can I request custom dimensions or colors?
faqs.answer: Custom size adaptations, bespoke glaze tones, and commissioned wirework trees are available for interior architects and private collectors. Simply initiate an inquiry via WhatsApp with your project requirements.
